cards.card_text: When a man who sinned against his neighbor takes an oath at the altar, Solomon asks God to judge: condemning the ___ man and justifying the ___ man.
cards.verse_text: May You judge Your servants, condemning the wicked man by bringing down on his own head what he has done, and justifying the righteous man by rewarding him according to his righteousness.
cards.snippet: …by bringing down on his own head what he has done, and justifying the righteous man by rewarding him according to his righteousness.
